messages:
eli: quick flag 1 Emerald-int4 canary cohort B shows parse failures for web_search funcalls. rate 0.9% -> 4.5% after roll. samples and dumps incoming.
sasha: can you drop the dashboard link? want to see failing prompts distribution.
eli: https://grafana.redwood/emerald-canary -> query funcall_parse_fail_rate{model="emerald-int4"}. top routes: /agent/web_search, /agent/summarize. examples below.
eli: ```
{"tool":"web_search","args": {"q":"redwood inference intro"}}}
{"tool":"web_search","args": {"q":"redwood inference intro"},}
{"tool":"web_search","args":"q=redwood inference intro"}...TRAILING_TEXT
```
ben: looks like trailing commas and non-json suffixes. suspect tokenization/eos alignment with int4 kernels.
priya: ben can you repro with tokenizer dumps int8 vs int4 and check token ids near EOS? also check kvcache on streaming.
ben: running: `python -m rl_onboard.playground --model emerald --quant int4 --seed 42 --route /agent/web_search --n 2000 --dump-tokens`
canary-bot: ALERT: Emerald-canary cohort B threshold breached (parse_fail_rate 4.5%). Incident INC-2026-834 created.
ravi: we saw a similar KV prefix interaction previously. cheap mitigation: disable KV cache or lower batch size for cohort.
ben: quick repro: int8 parse_fail 0.8%, int4 4.4%. int4 token dump shows extra 502-like token sequence at end leading to suffix. disabling kvcache + batch_size=1 -> int4 parse_fail 1.0%.
sasha: good signal. plan: (1) enable a tolerant postprocess healer + label outputs it touches, (2) disable kvcache for int4 cohort, (3) open kernel triage for token alignment.
priya: I'll run the structured-eval suite (10k golden prompts) to measure schema conformance delta int8 vs int4.
b en: pushing small healer: on parse_error try regex strip trailing commas and trailing non-brace suffix, up to 2 retries. add metric healer_applied and label `heuristic_healed`.
eli: pause further emerald-int4 rollout. route traffic to int8 mirror. create triage ticket.
eli: created ONB-942: "emerald-int4 kvcache alignment triage" and attached token dumps.
canary-bot: NOTE: healer deployed to cohort B at 1789999028. monitoring healer_success_rate.
sasha: initial numbers (first 1.2k reqs): raw parse_fail 4.4% -> post-healer 2.1% (healer fixed ~52% of failures). disabling kvcache cut failures further.
priya: keep healer on for 24h canary window. don't merge to stable until kernel fix. I'll report structured-eval results asap.
eli: thanks everyone, we'll sync tomorrow with postmortem notes.
